meta.description: Semi-arid lowland pastoral zone, 350–1000m. High drought frequency.
meta.admin: SNNPR – South Omo zone / Segen Area Peoples

data_sources.soil: SoilGrids v2.0 — ISRIC REST API (shallowest depth ~0-5cm)
data_sources.dem: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 100m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.modis_lpi: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 250m EPSG:32637 — Planetary Computer
data_sources.chirps: CHIRPS v2.0 2014–2023 annual TIFs — CHC UCSB /vsicurl/
data_sources.era5: ERA5-Land 2023 via Open-Meteo historical-forecast-api (free, no credentials)

community_intelligence.community_preferred_future: Maintain pastoral mobility; improve dry-season water access; reduce drought livestock losses
community_intelligence.local_degradation_memory: Rangeland severely degraded since 2009 drought; Prosopis invasion expanding annually
community_intelligence.grazing_rules: Traditional Dagu seasonal mobility routes disrupted by Gibe III dam and expanding agriculture
community_intelligence.labor_constraints: Pastoral labor fully committed to herd management; low-labor or livestock-integrated restoration only
community_intelligence.gendered_burdens: Women: small ruminants, water fetching (4-6h/day in dry season), household food security
community_intelligence.youth_opportunities: Early warning monitoring, Prosopis processing enterprise, rangeland monitoring technicians
community_intelligence.local_conflict_risks: Inter-ethnic conflicts (Mursi-Bodi, Daasanach-Hamar) over water/grazing — VERY HIGH SENSITIVITY
community_intelligence.tenure_constraints: Communal rangeland with no land certificates; high vulnerability to external acquisition
